name: secret_drawer
description: beneath the cot, a floorboard is loose. lifting it reveals a small hollow containing a bundle of letters tied with string, a small pouch of coins, and a faded photograph of a woman.

params.description: a bundle of letters from margaret holloway to james blackwood. 'dear james, i know we cannot be together in this house. but i watch for you at the garden gate every evening. meet me by the oak tree. i have news i can only share in person. — yours, forever, m.'
params.name: margaret_letters
